headline: Tighter liquidity environment may benefit SBI

highlights: Management was a bit conservative in terms of domestic NIM guidance as it may surprise positively led by full impact of loan repricing while SBI may not compete aggressively on deposit pricing given adequate liquidity buffer.

Despite achieving only 38-41% of targeted credit accretion in H1FY27, bank sounded confident of achieving loan growth guidance of 14-15% YoY in FY27 due to decent corporate pipeline and healthy RAM growth.
Steady quarter; lower loan growth offset by better NIM: NII at INR491.4bn was 1.5% higher due to NIM (calc.) that was a beat at 2.84% (PLe 2.77%); reported NIM was up 8bps QoQ to 2.94%.
Core PAT was 7.6% above PLe at INR180.3bn; PAT was INR230.4bn.

Despite achieving only 38-41% of targeted credit accretion in H1FY27, bank sounded confident of achieving loan growth guidance of 14-15% YoY in FY27 due to decent corporate pipeline and healthy RAM growth.
We tweak multiple to 1.3x from 1.4x but keep TP at INR1,200 as we roll forward to Sep’28 core ABV.
